pilot.why: The model of the partner that sponsors this project, built for agent and coding work (released and open-sourced 2026-05-29). Must be in the study; its AA score was not readable, so the pilot measures it directly.
StepFun's flagship. Same lab as the Flash model, so the pair shows what the bigger model buys. AA 44.
Our baseline: every earlier run used it, so it anchors the comparison. Cheap and the fastest of the set.
Best score for its price among models we can call (AA 42 at $0.28 per task): the value pick.
Top of the open models we can call (AA 44), built for long agent work. Slow and costly, so it shows whether the extra cost pays.
A fourth lab at a low price (AA 40 for the Flash-Next listing, which we assume matches this endpoint).

considered_not_in_pilot.why: AA 45 but $5.41 per task and 38 tokens/s: too costly for a pilot. Candidate for the full benchmark.
AA 46 at $0.13 per task is the best value on the board, but our Paratera key gets 403 (team not allowed). Ask Paratera for access.
AA 36, below the Flash model, and slower and costlier. No reason to include.
AA 29 and it failed our JSON-mode smoke test.
AA 45 but $2.01 per task; the Flash version gives 42 for $0.28. Candidate for the full benchmark.
